blocks.en: Section 1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器(PFS)技術報告緒論：為何本指引聚焦於1mL長型玻璃注射器
blocks.en: Introduction to the Prefilled Syringe (PFS) Technical Report: Why This Guidance Focuses on the 1 mL Long Glass Syringe

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解預填充注射器 (Prefilled Syringe, PFS) 相較於小瓶 (vial) 和安瓿 (ampule) 的核心優勢，包括減少給藥錯誤、降低微生物污染風險與改善法規合規性
blocks.en: Understand the core advantages of the prefilled syringe (PFS) over the vial and ampule, including fewer dosing errors, lower risk of microbial contamination and better regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 掌握本技術報告的範疇：聚焦於生技大分子藥品所用的1 mL長型玻璃PFS，明確排除塑膠注射器與自動注射器
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of this technical report: 1 mL long glass PFS for biotech large-molecule drug products, with plastic syringes and autoinjectors explicitly excluded

blocks.zh: 理解報告中「使用者 (end user)」、「客戶 (customer)」等術語在不同產品生命週期階段的定義差異
blocks.en: Understand how terms such as "end user" and "customer" are defined differently at different stages of the product life cycle

blocks.zh: 認識報告的章節結構：chevron圖（箭頭導覽圖）作為各章閱讀指引，以及PFS組件的標準術語
blocks.en: Become familiar with the structure of the report: the chevron diagram (arrow-shaped navigation graphic) as a reading guide for each section, and the standard terminology for PFS components

blocks.zh: 瞭解本報告如何在美/歐法規重點下，兼顧不同司法管轄區的資格認定與驗證要求
blocks.en: Understand how the report, while focused on US/EU regulations, accommodates the qualification and validation expectations of different jurisdictions

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 為什麼選擇PFS？三大驅動力：
blocks.en: Why choose a PFS? Three drivers:

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 優先：PFS減少注射前的操作步驟（如從小瓶抽藥），直接降低微生物污染 (microbial contamination) 的機會窗口。
blocks.en: Sterility assurance first: A PFS reduces the handling steps before injection (such as drawing the product from a vial), directly lowering the window of opportunity for microbial contamination.

blocks.zh: 產品CQAs保護：更少的操作步驟意味著更少的給藥錯誤 (dosing errors) 風險，保護Critical Quality Attributes（關鍵品質屬性）。
blocks.en: Protection of product CQAs: Fewer handling steps mean a lower risk of dosing errors, protecting the Critical Quality Attributes.

blocks.zh: 商業彈性：PFS的過量充填 (overfill) 法規要求通常低於小瓶，直接降低原料藥 (Drug Substance) 的浪費，對高成本生技大分子尤其重要。
blocks.en: Commercial flexibility: The regulatory overfill requirement for a PFS is usually lower than for a vial, directly reducing waste of Drug Substance, which matters especially for high-cost biotech large molecules.

blocks.zh: 範疇邊界 (Scope Boundary) 的重要性：本報告明確限定在1 mL長型玻璃PFS，排除塑膠注射器和自動注射器 (autoinjector)。這不是任意的，而是因為玻璃與塑膠的材料相容性評估方法截然不同，混用會造成法規論述的模糊。
blocks.en: Why the scope boundary matters: The report is explicitly limited to the 1 mL long glass PFS and excludes plastic syringes and autoinjectors. This is not arbitrary: the methods for assessing material compatibility differ fundamentally between glass and plastic, and mixing them would blur the regulatory argument.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把PFS想像成「即食便當」，把小瓶想像成「需要自己煮的食材包」。即食便當（PFS）讓你直接食用，減少備餐過程中食物受汙染或備錯份量的機會；食材包（小瓶）雖然有彈性，但每次開封、量取、轉移的步驟都是潛在的汙染或錯誤點。對生技注射劑來說，「備餐失誤」可能是病人安全問題，代價遠高於食物浪費。
blocks.en: Think of the PFS as a ready-to-eat meal box and the vial as a meal kit you have to cook yourself. The ready meal (PFS) can be eaten directly, reducing the chances of contamination or wrong portions during meal preparation. The meal kit (vial) is flexible, but every opening, measuring and transfer step is a potential point of contamination or error. For a biotech injectable, a "meal-prep mistake" can become a patient safety issue, at a cost far greater than wasted food.

blocks.zh: 本報告的章節chevron圖（箭頭圖）就像便當盒的層次說明書：從PFS開發授權（Section 3）到人因工程（Section 4）、提取物（Section 5）、玻璃/針頭/針頭保護套（Sections 6-8），再到外觀瑕疵（Section 9）、矽化（Section 10）、活塞（Section 11）、容器密封完整性（Section 12），最後到製造（Section 13）和藥品相容性（Section 14）。每一章聚焦一個「便當格」。
blocks.en: The chevron diagram in this report is like the compartment guide on a meal box: from PFS development and licensing (Section 3) to human factors (Section 4), extractables (Section 5), glass, needle and needle shield (Sections 6-8), then cosmetic imperfections (Section 9), siliconization (Section 10), plunger stopper (Section 11), container closure integrity (Section 12), and finally manufacturing (Section 13) and drug product compatibility (Section 14). Each section focuses on one "compartment".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「使用者」定義隨生命週期而變：這是本報告的重要提醒。在開發階段，「end user（最終使用者）」是目標病人；但在製造和供應階段，「customer（客戶）」可能是供應商或製造商。作為CDMO，我們在不同階段扮演不同角色——既是藥品持有人 (MAH) 的供應商（製造階段），也是元件供應商的客戶（採購階段）。閱讀本報告時需隨時確認當前討論中「使用者」指的是誰。
blocks.en: The definition of "user" changes with the life cycle: This is an important reminder in the report. During development, the "end user" is the target patient; during manufacturing and supply, the "customer" may be a supplier or a manufacturer. As a CDMO, we play different roles at different stages: we are a supplier to the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) (manufacturing stage) and also a customer of the component suppliers (purchasing stage). When reading this report, always confirm who "user" refers to in the passage being discussed.

blocks.zh: 美/歐聚焦，但需注意其他市場：本報告以美國FDA和歐洲EMA要求為主要參考框架，但明確指出不同司法管轄區（如台灣TFDA、日本PMDA）的要求可能有所不同。在台灣CDMO環境中，必須額外確認TFDA對PFS資格認定和驗證的具體要求。
blocks.en: US/EU focus, but watch other markets: The report uses US FDA and European EMA requirements as its main frame of reference, but states clearly that requirements in other jurisdictions (such as Taiwan TFDA and Japan PMDA) may differ. In a Taiwan CDMO setting, you must additionally confirm the specific TFDA requirements for PFS qualification and validation.

blocks.zh: 決策層級原則：本報告隱含的決策層級為：無菌保證 > 產品CQAs > 商業彈性。PFS的一切設計和選材決策，都應以此層級為依據。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy: The decision hierarchy implicit in the report is: sterility assurance > product CQAs > commercial flexibility. All PFS design and material selection decisions should be based on this hierarchy.

blocks.zh: Figure 1.1-1 PFS組件術語說明
blocks.en: Figure 1.1-1 PFS Component Terminology

blocks.zh: 本圖無影像檔，但來源文本列出了標準PFS的11個組件。作為CDMO工程師，這些術語在客戶技術文件、供應商規格書和法規申請文件中必須精確使用，不可混用或自創中譯：
blocks.en: There is no image file for this figure, but the source text lists the 11 components of a standard PFS. As a CDMO engineer, you must use these terms precisely in customer technical documents, supplier specifications and regulatory filings, without mixing them or inventing your own translations:

blocks.zh: Thumb pad（拇指墊）：給藥時拇指施力的平台
blocks.en: Thumb pad: The platform on which the thumb applies force during administration

blocks.zh: Plunger rod（推桿）：連接拇指墊與活塞的桿件
blocks.en: Plunger rod: The rod connecting the thumb pad to the plunger

blocks.zh: Finger flange（指法蘭）：食指和中指抓握的翼片
blocks.en: Finger flange: The wings gripped by the index and middle fingers

blocks.zh: Barrel（筒身）：容納藥液的玻璃管，Type I硼矽酸玻璃
blocks.en: Barrel: The glass tube that holds the drug solution, made of Type I borosilicate glass

blocks.zh: Cone（錐頭）：筒身前端，固定針頭的部位
blocks.en: Cone: The front end of the barrel, where the needle is held

blocks.zh: Needle（針頭）：不鏽鋼材質，以黏著劑固定於錐頭（staked needle設計）
blocks.en: Needle: Made of stainless steel and fixed to the cone with adhesive (staked needle design)

blocks.zh: Needle shield（針頭保護套）：彈性材料製，保護針頭並維持無菌
blocks.en: Needle shield: Made of elastomeric material; protects the needle and maintains sterility

blocks.zh: Shoulder（肩部）：筒身與錐頭的過渡區域
blocks.en: Shoulder: The transition area between the barrel and the cone

blocks.zh: Drug solution（藥液）：已充填的注射用藥品
blocks.en: Drug solution: The filled injectable drug product

blocks.zh: Plunger stopper（活塞膠塞）：彈性材料製的密封元件，直接接觸藥液
blocks.en: Plunger stopper: The elastomeric sealing element that is in direct contact with the drug solution

blocks.zh: Plunger（活塞）：整個活塞組件（stopper + rod）的總稱，有時特指膠塞本身
blocks.en: Plunger: The collective term for the whole plunger assembly (stopper + rod); sometimes it refers specifically to the stopper itself

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: PFS相較於小瓶的三大優勢中，哪一項在生技大分子藥品（如單株抗體）的CDMO製造情境中最具商業意義？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the three advantages of a PFS over a vial, which one carries the most commercial significance in the CDMO manufacture of biotech large-molecule drugs (such as monoclonal antibodies)? Why?

blocks.zh: 本報告排除塑膠注射器和自動注射器於範疇之外。若你的客戶想用自動注射器搭配生技藥品，本報告的哪些章節內容仍然適用？哪些需要額外的參考文獻？
blocks.en: This report excludes plastic syringes and autoinjectors from its scope. If your customer wants to use an autoinjector with a biologic product, which sections of this report still apply, and which need additional references?

blocks.zh: 「使用者」定義隨生命週期而變，請以你公司（CDMO）的角度，說明在PFS填充封閉 (fill-finish) 製造階段，你的「客戶」和「最終使用者」各是誰？這對品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 的撰寫有何影響？
blocks.en: The definition of "user" changes with the life cycle. From the perspective of your company (a CDMO), who are your "customer" and your "end user" at the PFS fill-finish manufacturing stage? How does this affect the drafting of the Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PFS的核心價值在於減少操作步驟，從而降低微生物污染風險和給藥錯誤——無菌保證始終是第一優先
blocks.en: The core value of a PFS lies in reducing handling steps, and thereby the risk of microbial contamination and dosing errors; sterility assurance is always the first priority

blocks.zh: 本報告範疇明確限定：1 mL長型玻璃PFS用於生技大分子藥品；塑膠注射器和自動注射器不在範疇內
blocks.en: The scope of the report is clearly limited: 1 mL long glass PFS for biotech large-molecule drug products; plastic syringes and autoinjectors are out of scope

blocks.zh: 「使用者」定義因產品生命週期階段而異，CDMO在不同階段可能同時扮演供應商和客戶兩種角色
blocks.en: The definition of "user" varies with the stage of the product life cycle; a CDMO may act as both supplier and customer at different stages

blocks.zh: Chevron圖是本報告的閱讀導引，反映從PFS開發授權到藥品相容性的完整操作順序（Sections 3-14）
blocks.en: The chevron diagram is the reading guide for the report and reflects the full operational sequence from PFS development and licensing to drug product compatibility (Sections 3-14)

blocks.zh: 11個PFS標準組件術語（Thumb pad至Plunger）是技術溝通的基礎，必須精確使用，不可自行創譯
blocks.en: The 11 standard PFS component terms (Thumb pad to Plunger) are the basis of technical communication and must be used precisely, without coining your own
